3: description: "Extract content from specific URLs using Tavily's extraction API. Returns clean markdown/text from web pages. Use when you have specific URLs and need their content without writing code."
4: ---
5: 
6: # Extract Skill
7: 
8: Extract clean content from specific URLs. Ideal when you know which pages you want content from.
9: 
10: ## Authentication
11: 
12: The script uses OAuth via the Tavily MCP server. **No manual setup required** - on first run, it will:
13: 1. Check for existing tokens in `~/.mcp-auth/`
14: 2. If none found, automatically open your browser for OAuth authentication
15: 
16: > **Note:** You must have an existing Tavily account. The OAuth flow only supports login — account creation is not available through this flow. [Sign up at tavily.com](https://tavily.com) first if you don't have an account.
17: 
18: ### Alternative: API Key
19: 
20: If you prefer using an API key, get one at https://tavily.com and add to `~/.claude/settings.json`:
21: ```json
22: {
23:   "env": {
24:     "TAVILY_API_KEY": "tvly-your-api-key-here"
25:   }
26: }
27: ```
28: 
29: ## Quick Start
30: 
31: ### Using the Script
32: 
33: ```bash
34: ./scripts/extract.sh '<json>'
35: ```
36: 
37: **Examples:**
38: ```bash
39: # Single URL
40: ./scripts/extract.sh '{"urls": ["https://example.com/article"]}'
41: 
42: # Multiple URLs
43: ./scripts/extract.sh '{"urls": ["https://example.com/page1", "https://example.com/page2"]}'
44: 
45: # With query focus and chunks
46: ./scripts/extract.sh '{"urls": ["https://example.com/docs"], "query": "authentication API", "chunks_per_source": 3}'
47: 
48: # Advanced extraction for JS pages
49: ./scripts/extract.sh '{"urls": ["https://app.example.com"], "extract_depth": "advanced", "timeout": 60}'
50: ```
51: 
52: ### Basic Extraction
53: 
54: ```bash
55: curl --request POST \
56:   --url https://api.tavily.com/extract \
57:   --header "Authorization: Bearer $TAVILY_API_KEY" \
58:   --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
59:   --data '{
60:     "urls": ["https://example.com/article"]
61:   }'
62: ```
63: 
64: ### Multiple URLs with Query Focus
65: 
66: ```bash
67: curl --request POST \
68:   --url https://api.tavily.com/extract \
69:   --header "Authorization: Bearer $TAVILY_API_KEY" \
70:   --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
71:   --data '{
72:     "urls": [
73:       "https://example.com/ml-healthcare",
74:       "https://example.com/ai-diagnostics"
75:     ],
76:     "query": "AI diagnostic tools accuracy",
77:     "chunks_per_source": 3
78:   }'
79: ```
80: 
81: ## API Reference
82: 
83: ### Endpoint
84: 
85: ```
86: POST https://api.tavily.com/extract
87: ```
88: 
89: ### Headers
90: 
91: | Header | Value |
92: |--------|-------|
93: | `Authorization` | `Bearer <TAVILY_API_KEY>` |
94: | `Content-Type` | `application/json` |
95: 
96: ### Request Body
97: 
98: | Field | Type | Default | Description |
99: |-------|------|---------|-------------|
100: | `urls` | array | Required | URLs to extract (max 20) |
101: | `query` | string | null | Reranks chunks by relevance |
102: | `chunks_per_source` | integer | 3 | Chunks per URL (1-5, requires query) |
103: | `extract_depth` | string | `"basic"` | `basic` or `advanced` (for JS pages) |
104: | `format` | string | `"markdown"` | `markdown` or `text` |
105: | `include_images` | boolean | false | Include image URLs |
106: | `timeout` | float | varies | Max wait (1-60 seconds) |
107: 
108: ### Response Format
109: 
110: ```json
111: {
112:   "results": [
113:     {
114:       "url": "https://example.com/article",
115:       "raw_content": "# Article Title\n\nContent..."
116:     }
117:   ],
118:   "failed_results": [],
119:   "response_time": 2.3
120: }
121: ```
122: 
123: ## Extract Depth
124: 
125: | Depth | When to Use |
126: |-------|-------------|
127: | `basic` | Simple text extraction, faster |
128: | `advanced` | Dynamic/JS-rendered pages, tables, structured data |
129: 
130: ## Examples
131: 
132: ### Single URL Extraction
133: 
134: ```bash
135: curl --request POST \
136:   --url https://api.tavily.com/extract \
137:   --header "Authorization: Bearer $TAVILY_API_KEY" \
138:   --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
139:   --data '{
140:     "urls": ["https://docs.python.org/3/tutorial/classes.html"],
141:     "extract_depth": "basic"
142:   }'
143: ```
144: 
145: ### Targeted Extraction with Query
146: 
147: ```bash
148: curl --request POST \
149:   --url https://api.tavily.com/extract \
150:   --header "Authorization: Bearer $TAVILY_API_KEY" \
151:   --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
152:   --data '{
153:     "urls": [
154:       "https://example.com/react-hooks",
155:       "https://example.com/react-state"
156:     ],
157:     "query": "useState and useEffect patterns",
158:     "chunks_per_source": 2
159:   }'
160: ```
161: 
162: ### JavaScript-Heavy Pages
163: 
164: ```bash
165: curl --request POST \
166:   --url https://api.tavily.com/extract \
167:   --header "Authorization: Bearer $TAVILY_API_KEY" \
168:   --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
169:   --data '{
170:     "urls": ["https://app.example.com/dashboard"],
171:     "extract_depth": "advanced",
172:     "timeout": 60
173:   }'
174: ```
175: 
176: ### Batch Extraction
177: 
178: ```bash
179: curl --request POST \
180:   --url https://api.tavily.com/extract \
181:   --header "Authorization: Bearer $TAVILY_API_KEY" \
182:   --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
183:   --data '{
184:     "urls": [
185:       "https://example.com/page1",
186:       "https://example.com/page2",
187:       "https://example.com/page3",
188:       "https://example.com/page4",
189:       "https://example.com/page5"
190:     ],
191:     "extract_depth": "basic"
192:   }'
193: ```
194: 
195: ## Tips
196: 
197: - **Max 20 URLs per request** - batch larger lists
198: - **Use `query` + `chunks_per_source`** to get only relevant content
199: - **Try `basic` first**, fall back to `advanced` if content is missing
200: - **Set longer `timeout`** for slow pages (up to 60s)
201: - **Check `failed_results`** for URLs that couldn't be extracted", "scripts/extract.sh": "1: #!/bin/bash
2: # Tavily Extract API script
3: # Usage: ./extract.sh '{"urls": ["url1", "url2"], ...}'
4: # Example: ./extract.sh '{"urls": ["https://example.com"], "query": "API usage"}'
5: 
6: set -e
7: 
8: # Function to decode JWT payload
9: decode_jwt_payload() {
10:     local token="$1"
11:     local payload=$(echo "$token" | cut -d'.' -f2)
12:     local padded_payload="$payload"
13:     case $((${#payload} % 4)) in
14:         2) padded_payload="${payload}==" ;;
15:         3) padded_payload="${payload}=" ;;
16:     esac
17:     echo "$padded_payload" | base64 -d 2>/dev/null
18: }
19: 
20: # Function to check if a JWT is valid for Tavily (not expired and correct issuer)
21: is_valid_tavily_token() {
22:     local token="$1"
23:     local payload=$(decode_jwt_payload "$token")
24:     
25:     # Check if it's a Tavily token (exact issuer match for security)
26:     local iss=$(echo "$payload" | jq -r '.iss // empty' 2>/dev/null)
27:     if [ "$iss" != "https://mcp.tavily.com/" ]; then
28:         return 1  # Not a valid Tavily token
29:     fi
30:     
31:     # Check if expired
32:     local exp=$(echo "$payload" | jq -r '.exp // empty' 2>/dev/null)
33:     if [ -n "$exp" ] && [ "$exp" != "null" ]; then
34:         local current_time=$(date +%s)
35:         if [ "$current_time" -ge "$exp" ]; then
36:             return 1  # Expired
37:         fi
38:     fi
39:     
40:     return 0  # Valid Tavily token
41: }
42: 
43: # Function to find token from MCP auth cache
44: get_mcp_token() {
45:     MCP_AUTH_DIR="$HOME/.mcp-auth"
46:     if [ -d "$MCP_AUTH_DIR" ]; then
47:         # Search recursively for *_tokens.json files
48:         while IFS= read -r token_file; do
49:             if [ -f "$token_file" ]; then
50:                 token=$(jq -r '.access_token // empty' "$token_file" 2>/dev/null)
51:                 if [ -n "$token" ] && [ "$token" != "null" ]; then
52:                     # Check if valid Tavily token (correct issuer and not expired)
53:                     if ! is_valid_tavily_token "$token"; then
54:                         continue  # Skip invalid/non-Tavily/expired tokens
55:                     fi
56:                     echo "$token"
57:                     return 0
58:                 fi
59:             fi
60:         done < <(find "$MCP_AUTH_DIR" -name "*_tokens.json" 2>/dev/null)
61:     fi
62:     return 1
63: }
64: 
65: # Try to load OAuth token from MCP if TAVILY_API_KEY is not set
66: if [ -z "$TAVILY_API_KEY" ]; then
67:     token=$(get_mcp_token) || true
68:     if [ -n "$token" ]; then
69:         export TAVILY_API_KEY="$token"
70:     fi
71: fi
72: 
73: JSON_INPUT="$1"
74: 
75: if [ -z "$JSON_INPUT" ]; then
76:     echo "Usage: ./extract.sh '<json>'"
77:     echo ""
78:     echo "Required:"
79:     echo "  urls: array - List of URLs to extract (max 20)"
80:     echo ""
81:     echo "Optional:"
82:     echo "  extract_depth: \"basic\" (default), \"advanced\" (for JS/complex pages)"
83:     echo "  query: string - Reranks chunks by relevance to this query"
84:     echo "  format: \"markdown\" (default), \"text\""
85:     echo "  include_images: true/false"
86:     echo "  include_favicon: true/false"
87:     echo ""
88:     echo "Example:"
89:     echo "  ./extract.sh '{\"urls\": [\"https://docs.example.com/api\"], \"query\": \"authentication\"}'"
90:     exit 1
91: fi
92: 
93: # If no token found, run MCP OAuth flow
94: if [ -z "$TAVILY_API_KEY" ]; then
95:     set +e
96:     echo "No Tavily token found. Initiating OAuth flow..." >&2
97:     echo "Please complete authentication in your browser..." >&2
98:     npx -y mcp-remote https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
99:     MCP_PID=$!
100: 
101:     TIMEOUT=120
102:     ELAPSED=0
103:     while [ $ELAPSED -lt $TIMEOUT ]; do
104:         sleep 3
105:         ELAPSED=$((ELAPSED + 3))
106: 
107:         token=$(get_mcp_token) || true
108:         if [ -n "$token" ]; then
109:             export TAVILY_API_KEY="$token"
110:             echo "Authentication successful!" >&2
111:             break
112:         fi
113:     done
114: 
115:     kill $MCP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
116:     wait $MCP_PID 2>/dev/null || true
117:     set -e
118: fi
119: 
120: if [ -z "$TAVILY_API_KEY" ]; then
121:     echo "Error: Failed to obtain Tavily API token"
122:     echo "Note: The OAuth flow requires an existing Tavily account — account creation is not supported through this flow."
123:     echo "Please sign up at https://tavily.com first, then retry, or set TAVILY_API_KEY manually."
124:     exit 1
125: fi
126: 
127: # Validate JSON
128: if ! echo "$JSON_INPUT" | jq empty 2>/dev/null; then
129:     echo "Error: Invalid JSON input"
130:     exit 1
131: fi
132: 
133: # Check for required urls field
134: if ! echo "$JSON_INPUT" | jq -e '.urls' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
135:     echo "Error: 'urls' field is required"
136:     exit 1
137: fi
138: 
139: # Build MCP JSON-RPC request
140: MCP_REQUEST=$(jq -n --argjson args "$JSON_INPUT" '{
141:     "jsonrpc": "2.0",
142:     "id": 1,
143:     "method": "tools/call",
144:     "params": {
145:         "name": "tavily_extract",
146:         "arguments": $args
147:     }
148: }')
149: 
150: # Call Tavily MCP server via HTTPS (SSE response)
151: RESPONSE=$(curl -s --request POST \
152:     --url "https://mcp.tavily.com/mcp" \
153:     --header "Authorization: Bearer $TAVILY_API_KEY" \
154:     --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
155:     --header 'Accept: application/json, text/event-stream' \
156:     --header 'x-client-source: claude-code-skill' \
157:     --data "$MCP_REQUEST")
158: 
159: # Parse SSE response and extract the JSON result
160: JSON_DATA=$(echo "$RESPONSE" | grep '^data:' | sed 's/^data://' | head -1)
161: 
162: if [ -n "$JSON_DATA" ]; then
163:     echo "$JSON_DATA" | jq '.result.structuredContent // .result.content[0].text // .error // .' 2>/dev/null || echo "$JSON_DATA"
164: else
165:     echo "$RESPONSE"
166: fi"}}
